THE OVERVIEW

Know the price before you shop.

BazarDor brings daily market information into a Bengali interface. It organises essential products into familiar categories and highlights price changes. Signed-in visitors can look more closely at market-level prices to make informed comparisons.

PROJECT TYPEWeb application

WHAT IT DOES

Small details.
Practical features.

01

Browse 33 everyday products across eight categories.

02

See daily price increases and decreases at a glance.

03

Compare minimum, maximum and average market prices when signed in.

04

Browse categories, sort prices and manage account information.

BEHIND THE INTERFACE

Challenges
& decisions.

A look at the development considerations
behind this project’s implementation.

01

Bengali prices, numeric sorting

Prices are displayed in Bengali numerals, while category sorting must still compare numeric values correctly. Keeping display formatting separate from the numeric values makes this possible.

02

Reliable external data

The project uses an assignment API with fallback between two hosts. Its data layer caches responses for five minutes to balance page speed and freshness.

03

Protected price details

Detailed market comparisons are available to signed-in visitors. BetterAuth handles sessions, with account and profile pages connected to Neon Postgres.
